observed: Four pale yellow cylindrical corner towers have red rounded domes, small ring windows and pale lanterns; a taller slender dark chapel spire rises over the pitched roof complex.
Connected yellow/cream ranges have white pilasters and many vertically aligned windows, red hipped roofs, selected dormers, and one projecting entrance range.
A low stone terrace/base projects around the whole palace, with repeated lower openings, broad curving stairs and ramps; the rectangle includes curved terrace fronts.

Rectangular island gardens have pale paths, retaining water edges and multiple small square corner pavilions with red hip roofs. Causeways extend toward the town and northern gardens; the main lake remains host water/terrain.
